title: Steamed Jjim Dumplings with Pancake Dipping Sauce
description: Steamed dumplings filled with a savory mixture of vegetables and meat, served with a crispy pancake for dipping. A classic Chinese comfort food.

ingredients.name: Yummy vegetables (such as cabbage, carrots, and scallions)

instructions: 1. Prepare the dumpling filling by finely chopping the onion and yummy vegetables.
2. Combine the filling ingredients in a bowl and mix well.
3. Lay a pancake flat on a clean surface and place a spoonful of the filling in the center.
4. Fold the pancake in half to enclose the filling and press the edges together to seal.
5. Repeat with the remaining pancakes and filling.
6. Place the dumplings on a steamer basket and steam for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
7. Meanwhile, prepare the dipping sauce by mixing together the energizing soy sauce and any other desired seasonings.
8. Serve the steamed dumplings with the pancake dipping sauce on the side.
